annotations.title: Find print shops that can make it

description: Who can make this? Reads the PTPGE vendor register and every claimed print shop's own declaration (/.well-known/ptpge/declaration.json — the file is the source) and filters on what the documents say: country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), product template (e.g. ordering/products/booklets or just «booklets»), printing technology (a term under printing/technologies/printing-technologies — a parent matches its children, so «digital» finds laser and inkjet), certification (e.g. nordic-swan-ecolabel), substrate, or free text on name/city. Returns each matching shop with its identity, countries and cities, products, technologies, certifications, the matching offerings (minimum quantity, lead time) and the doors an agent needs next: the declaration, the UCP manifest, the register entry. Never ranked, never priced — for price and an order use the shop's own MCP endpoint from its manifest; the spec fingerprint is the same key everywhere. Read-only; cached ten minutes; nothing stored.

certification.description: Certification term: URI, path or slug (nordic-swan-ecolabel, fsc, trykt-i-norge …).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. NO, DE, US.

product.description: Product template: URI, /v1/ path or slug (booklets, business-cards, posters …).

substrate.description: Substrate term: URI, path or slug (paper, cardboard, vinyl …).

technology.description: Printing technology term: URI, path or slug (offset, digital, laser, uv-inkjet …).

text.description: Free text matched against name, legal name, domain and cities.
